events_none: (No economy events yet - famine/plunder/revolution/unrest will appear here)
ev_desc_uprising: Street uprising ({0} rich executed, regime collapsed)
ev_desc_era_flourish: {0} enters a Flourishing Era (army power up)
ev_desc_collapse: Economic Collapse! {0}'s wealth evaporates, citizens suffer
ev_desc_policy: Wealth redistribution policy adopted, wealth gap decreases
ev_desc_unrest_peace: Peace treaty with the rebels; unrest ends, kingdom recovers
ev_desc_unrest_resolved: Rebellion quelled, cities recaptured, kingdom recovers
ev_desc_policy_fail_civilwar: Reform failed! The kingdom falls into civil war
ev_desc_king_inherit: A new king ascends the throne
chart_legend_hint: Kingdom lines appear by rank: enter to show, fall to break, re-enter to resume
gini_legend_phase: Background bands = phase (green boom / orange recession / red depression / blue recovery)
gini_legend_danger: Red line = wealth gap danger line
gini_legend_health: Green line = wealth gap health line
picker_hint: Click a kingdom's Incite/Suppress buttons to act on that kingdom
rich_noworld: (No world loaded — enter a world, the list auto-refreshes yearly)
ui_language Description: UI language: auto = follow the game's language setting (default); or force zh / zh_tw / en / ru
unrest_enabled Description: Auto-detect high-wealth-gap kingdoms and trigger vanilla rebellion
log_worldlog Description: When ON, logs cycle wealth, kingdom wealth, unrest events, etc.
gini_threshold Description: Unrest triggers when wealth gap ≥ this value
unrest_grace_years Description: No unrest in the first N years
unrest_max_cities Description: Max cities rebelling per kingdom per outbreak; actual count is random and grows with the wealth gap (min 1)
policy_enabled Description: High-gap kingdoms auto-try wealth redistribution policy; may fail (ruler abdicates, dies, or the kingdom falls into civil war), success lowers the Gini index
cycle_enabled Description: Runs the 4-phase cycle; phase transitions are driven by the global wealth gap
cycle_gini_high Description: Gap ≥ this means imbalance (boom bursts to recession, recession to depression)
cycle_gini_low Description: Gap ≤ this means equality (depression/recovery move toward boom)
cycle_gini_periods Description: Cycles the gap must stay across the line before phase shifts (lower = faster cycles)
boom_stimulus_ratio Description: Coins injected per cycle as a share of GDP during boom (credit expansion)
boom_bubble_factor Description: Bubble accumulation speed during boom (injection × factor)
bubble_threshold Description: Bubble bursts and coins evaporate when accumulated value exceeds this
boom_max_duration Description: Boom shifts to recession after this many cycles
recession_max_duration Description: Recession shifts to depression after this many cycles
depression_max_duration Description: Depression shifts to recovery after this many cycles
recovery_max_duration Description: Recovery shifts to boom after this many cycles
survival_line Description: Economy turns depressed when average wealth falls below this
war_plunder_ratio Description: Share of the loser kingdom's coins plundered by the winner after a war
war_waste_ratio Description: Share of plunder that evaporates (war damage, not transferred). Deducted from the rich first, lowering the Gini coefficient
revolution_delay_years Description: A kingdom falls when its rebellion lasts this many years
revolution_kill_ratio Description: Share of the kingdom's population killed during a revolution
uprising_gini_threshold Description: After a rebellion, if the Gini stays at/above this for N years, a street uprising erupts (all-city revolt + kill the rich + overthrow the king)
uprising_delay_years Description: Years the Gini must stay above the uprising threshold after a rebellion before the regime collapses
kill_rich_ratio Description: Share of the kingdom's richest citizens executed during uprising/revolution (0.05 = top 5%)
kill_rich_redist_ratio Description: Share of executed rich citizens' wealth given to the poorest (rest evaporates/drops); higher cuts Gini faster
economy_collect_description: Manually run data collection and recalculation
wealth_tax_enabled Description: Each year taxes all citizens above the tax line and redistributes to the poor, steadily reducing the wealth gap
wealth_tax_ratio Description: Tax ratio on the amount above the tax line (0-0.5); higher reduces the gap faster
wealth_tax_line Description: Citizens with wealth above avg × this pay tax (1.0-3.0); those below avg × 0.8 receive subsidies
era_enabled Description: Golden Age / Revival / Flourishing / Collapse (triggered by rich spending or the cycle; citizens gain real bonuses)
era_duration_years Description: How long Golden Age / Revival / Flourishing last before auto-removal
collapse_drop_ratio Description: Collapse triggers when a kingdom's avg wealth drops ≥ this YoY during Depression
collapse_duration_years Description: How long Economic Collapse lasts before auto-removal
flourish_periods Description: Consecutive cycles meeting Flourishing conditions before triggering (debounce)
labor_enabled Description: Workers create wages each year by occupation productivity (labor creates wealth; the jobless produce nothing)
labor_wage_base Description: Annual wage = base × occupation multiplier (miner 1.3 / hunter 1.1 / farmer 1.0...)
real_time_refresh Description: Recalculate stats and refresh the HUD every N seconds (no wages/tax; keeps yearly cycle intact)
real_time_refresh_threshold Description: Skip recompute when alive units reach this (UI-only refresh) (100-100000, default 2000)
real_time_refresh_budget Description: Max alive units processed per lightweight refresh (100-100000, default 2000)
money_velocity Description: Money supply multiplier; higher = faster inflation transmission
inflation_bubble_boost Description: Bubble accumulation accelerates under high inflation
disaster_enabled Description: Disasters evaporate city wealth (population/city crash or hazard tile)
disaster_wealth_loss Description: Share of wealth lost in hit cities (0-0.8)
disaster_mine_bonus Description: Mining output bonus for hit areas during boom (0-1)
banking_enabled Description: The rich lend; in depression the default rate surges and contagion hits weaker kingdoms
credit_rate Description: Credit scale = rich wealth × credit rate (0.01-0.5)
crisis_contagion_threshold Description: When the default rate exceeds this value, contagion hits weaker kingdoms (0.05-0.5)
spending_cap_per_year Description: Max wealthy actors processed per year (default 5000, lower to throttle)
banking_default_cap_per_year Description: Max kingdoms processed for credit/defaults per year (default 500)
banking_contagion_cap_per_year Descripti: Max contagion partners evaluated per year (default 500)
frame_budget_ms Description: Max ms the annual closeout state machine advances per frame (1-100, default 4; snapshot/UI only after all stages)
cycle_window_ms Description: Total ms allowed for the whole annual closeout (100-10000, default 2000; on timeout extend to 5000ms first, then reduce spending->banking->other, tax never reduced)
inheritance_scan_per_frame Description: Max alive units scanned per frame in the 3-second inheritance window (default 2000)
perf_diagnostics_enabled Description: When ON, records closeout stage times (Stopwatch) and managed-memory deltas (GC.GetTotalMemory(false)); logs only over-budget stages plus one yearly summary. OFF = zero overhead (default)
cycle_alloc_budget Description: Per-cycle managed-allocation budget in KB (default 4096 = 4MB); the yearly summary flags a cycle whose total allocation delta exceeds this
memory_cleanup_enabled Description: When ON, trims static scratch/cache collections (TrimExcess) at intervals while the game is idle (default ON)
memory_cleanup_force_gc Description: Whether to run one System.GC.Collect when the cleanup interval fires (the only GC entry point in the mod; default OFF)
memory_cleanup_interval_seconds Descript: Minimum seconds between two automatic memory cleanups (5-300, default 30)
memory_cleanup_notify_enabled Descriptio: Shows a top-banner toast when an automatic memory cleanup frees a meaningful amount (default ON); the HUD memory status line and logs are unaffected by this switch
memory_cleanup_toast: Memory cleaned automatically: freed {0} MB ({1} buffers shrunk)
hud_mem_usage: Managed heap {0} MB | Unity used {1} MB (reserved {2} MB)
settling_hint: Annual settlement in progress: collection and phase switching are disabled
toast_policy_redistribute: [Policy] <{0}> enacted wealth redistribution; the gap is narrowing
toast_policy_tax_austerity: [Policy] <{0}> raised taxes to replenish the treasury
toast_policy_fiscal_fail: [Policy] <{0}> failed to pass its fiscal policy; unrest grows
toast_policy_fail_civilwar: [Policy] <{0}> reform failed! The kingdom falls into civil war
toast_uprising: [Uprising] <{0}> street uprising! {1} rich executed, the king is overthrown
toast_unrest_peace: [Unrest] <{0}> peace negotiated with rebels; order restored
toast_unrest_resolved: [Unrest] <{0}> revolt quelled, cities reclaimed; order restored
toast_bubble_burst: [Economy] Bubble bursts! {0} of wealth evaporates, {1} affected
toast_banking_crisis: [Economy] Banking crisis! Depression defaults spread to {0} kingdoms, {1} gold lost
toast_disaster: [Economy] Disaster strikes! {0} cities hit, {1} gold evaporates
ev_desc_policy_fail_fiscal: Reform failed! The fiscal policy was not enacted
economy_intervene_description: Select a kingdom to incite or suppress
cabinet_disabled: Central banker gameplay is disabled in settings
cabinet_no_nation: You have not claimed a nation yet
cabinet_claim_hint: Pick a kingdom to serve as its economy minister
cabinet_build_title: Construct buildings (own cities, one per city)
cabinet_no_cities: Your nation has no cities yet
toast_nation_claim: [Cabinet] You are now the economy minister of <{0}>, treasury {1} gold
toast_nation_unbind: [Cabinet] <{0}> has fallen; you step down as minister
toast_nation_destroyed_war: [Cabinet] War has destroyed a building of {0}!
toast_nation_destroyed_disaster: [Cabinet] Disaster has destroyed a building of {0}!
toast_nation_no_slot: [Cabinet] Policy slots full ({0}); cancel one first
toast_nation_built_already: [Cabinet] This city already has a building
toast_nation_build_unavailable: [Cabinet] No matching building asset in this game version
toast_nation_build_failed: [Cabinet] Construction failed; funds returned to treasury
nation_play_enabled Description: Enable central banker gameplay: claim a nation, royal treasury, ongoing policies and one-shot decrees (default ON)
treasury_income_ratio Description: Percent of own city warehouse gold levied into the royal treasury each cycle (1-20, default 5)
toast_dip_peace_poor: [Diplomacy] Treasury cannot afford the peace terms
nation_claim_hotkey Description: Hover a kingdom on the map and press this key to claim/open the cabinet panel (Unity KeyCode name, e.g. G; blank disables; default G)
ui_scale Description: Overall scale of the cabinet panel font and buttons (0.8-1.6, default 1.2); takes effect immediately
cabinet_policy_hint: Ongoing policies occupy slots; enabling pays the first year, retiering pays a reform fee, cancelling is free
cabinet_decree_hint: One-shot decrees are instant; buildings are one per city and can be destroyed by wars and disasters
cabinet_diplomacy_hint: Real-time actions against a target: war/peace/alliance/pact/gift; 2 pact slots
toast_nation_place_mode: [Cabinet] Click your territory to place: {0} (right-click cancels)
toast_nation_place_territory: [Cabinet] Must be placed inside your nation
cabinet_place_hint: Pick a building to enter placement mode: click your territory to build, right-click to cancel
cabinet_gdp_chart_short: Not enough GDP data yet - the curve appears after a few cycles
ev_treasury_gap_desc: The treasury is nearly empty; the ministers argue over a blank ledger.
ev_treasury_gap_res1: The emergency tax has been collected into the treasury.
ev_treasury_gap_res2: The treasury sits empty; grumbling spreads among the people.
ev_tax_corruption_desc: The collectors skim; less gold reaches the treasury each year.
ev_tax_corruption_res1: The corrupt were purged; the crown's standing rose.
ev_tax_corruption_res2: The crown shares the spoils; discontent simmers.
ev_rich_petition_desc: Rich merchants offer gold for trading privileges.
ev_rich_petition_res1: Gold flows in; the merchants celebrate.
ev_rich_petition_res2: The petition is rejected; the merchants grow cold to the crown.
ev_drought_desc: The land cracks; grain prices climb daily.
ev_drought_res1: Granary grain is handed out; the people survive.
ev_drought_res2: The altars are built and torn down; no rain, only anger.
ev_locust_desc: A swarm blots out the sun; the fields are stripped.
ev_locust_res1: Every household hunts locusts; the blight is contained.
ev_locust_res2: The swarm leaves nothing; hunger spreads in the villages.
ev_quake_aftermath_desc: Aftershocks continue; rumors of doom spread.
ev_quake_aftermath_res1: Paid repairs rebuild homes and calm the people.
ev_quake_aftermath_res2: The ruins are ignored; rumors grow wilder.
ev_royal_wedding_desc: A royal wedding approaches; the steward brings two budgets.
ev_royal_wedding_res1: The feast impresses every court; envoys fill the gates.
ev_royal_wedding_res2: The modest rites leave the courts unimpressed.
ev_minister_power_desc: A minister packs the courts; decrees bear his seal alone.
ev_minister_power_res1: Power returns to the crown; the minister's faction seethes.
ev_minister_power_res2: The minister still rules; every court knows whose word goes.
ev_succession_dispute_desc: The succession is disputed; two factions deadlock.
ev_succession_dispute_opt2: Back the worthier, buy off the rest
ev_succession_dispute_res1: The elder heir prevails; the losing faction broods.
ev_succession_dispute_res2: Gold settles the dispute—at the treasury's expense.
ev_army_pay_desc: The frontier army is owed months of pay; envoys press for gold.
ev_army_pay_res1: The army is paid in full; morale soars.
ev_army_pay_res2: Pay is postponed again; grumbling fills the camps.
ev_mercenary_default_desc: Hired mercenaries demand back-pay at the worst moment.
ev_mercenary_default_res1: The debt is settled; the mercenaries stand down.
ev_mercenary_default_res2: Disbanded, the mercenaries turn to brigandage.
ev_prisoner_ransom_desc: The enemy offers ransom for captive nobles—or we may buy our own back.
ev_prisoner_ransom_res1: The captives come home; tensions ease a little.
ev_prisoner_ransom_res2: The ransom is refused; the enemy vows revenge.
ev_bread_riot_desc: Bread prices soar; a crowd gathers at the granary gates.
ev_bread_riot_res1: Grain is sold at fair prices; the streets calm down.
ev_bread_riot_res2: The crowd is dispersed; the anger is not.
ev_plague_desc: Plague spreads in the next province; physicians ask to act early.
ev_plague_res1: Physicians are funded; the plague stays outside.
ev_plague_res2: The gates are shut; trade withers.
ev_neighbor_extort_desc: A strong neighbor demands tribute—pay, or they will patrol the border.
ev_neighbor_extort_res1: The tribute is paid; the neighbor quiets down—for now.
ev_neighbor_extort_res2: The envoy is expelled; the border heats up.
ev_marriage_alliance_desc: A neighbor proposes a marriage alliance.
ev_marriage_alliance_res1: The marriage binds the two courts; envoys never cease.
event_choice_countdown: {0} year(s) left, then the cautious option is taken
toast_event_pending: A decision awaits the kingdom — open the Cabinet.
event_chance_player Description: Yearly chance of a decision event for your claimed kingdom (0-1; 0 disables).
event_chance_ai Description: Yearly chance for AI kingdoms (0-1); they decide by national character and the result lands in the event feed.
event_cooldown_years Description: Minimum years between any two kingdom events (1-10).
ev_treasury_gap_opt1_desc: Levy a one-off emergency tax on all residents to refill the treasury.
ev_treasury_gap_opt2_desc: Do nothing and tighten belts — unrest will grow.
ev_tax_corruption_opt1_desc: Purge the collectors; the crown pays for the investigation but honor is restored.
ev_tax_corruption_opt2_desc: Let them skim; the treasury nets more — corruption takes root.
ev_rich_petition_opt1_desc: Take the gold and grant the merchants their monopoly.
ev_rich_petition_opt2_desc: Reject the petition and fine the ringleaders.
ev_drought_opt1_desc: Open the granaries to feed the people — it will cost the treasury.
ev_drought_opt2_desc: Save the grain and let the people fend for themselves.
ev_locust_opt1_desc: Pay households in grain to hunt the locusts.
ev_locust_opt2_desc: Ignore it and leave the harvest to fate.
ev_quake_aftermath_opt1_desc: Fund paid repair works to rebuild homes and roads.
ev_quake_aftermath_opt2_desc: Release no funds; let the rumors die on their own.
ev_royal_wedding_opt1_desc: Throw a lavish feast the whole world will remember.
ev_royal_wedding_opt2_desc: Keep the rites modest but proper.
ev_minister_power_opt1_desc: Move against the minister and purge his faction.
ev_minister_power_opt2_desc: Leave things be to avoid shaking the court.
ev_succession_dispute_opt1_desc: Follow tradition and crown the elder heir.
ev_succession_dispute_opt2_desc: Pick the worthier heir and buy off the rest.
ev_army_pay_opt1_desc: Pay the arrears in full and steady the army.
ev_army_pay_opt2_desc: Keep delaying; the gold stays in the treasury.
ev_mercenary_default_opt1_desc: Honor the contract and keep the veterans.
ev_mercenary_default_opt2_desc: Disband them and save the wages.
ev_prisoner_ransom_opt1_desc: Pay the ransom and bring our people home.
ev_bread_riot_opt1_desc: Open the granaries and sell grain at fair prices.
ev_plague_opt1_desc: Fund physicians and medicine to keep the plague outside.
ev_plague_opt2_desc: Seal the gates and spend nothing.
ev_neighbor_extort_opt1_desc: Pay the tribute and buy peace.
ev_neighbor_extort_opt2_desc: Refuse outright — war if it must be.
ev_marriage_alliance_opt1_desc: Accept the marriage and bind the strong neighbor by blood.
ev_merchant_loan_desc: An envoy brings an offer: the merchant league will lend {kingdom} a fortune — no loan comes free.
ev_merchant_loan_opt1_desc: Take the gold now; repay with interest in two years.
ev_merchant_loan_res1: The gold is in; {king} sealed the contract.
ev_merchant_loan_opt2_desc: No foreign debts; {kingdom} minds its own purse.
ev_merchant_loan_res2: The offer is declined; {king} says {kingdom} owes no favors.
ev_loan_due_desc: Two years are up; the league collectors stand at the palace gates, and {king} must answer.
ev_loan_due_opt1_desc: Bleed the treasury but keep the crown's credit.
ev_loan_due_res1: The debt is paid with interest; {kingdom}'s credit grew.
ev_loan_due_opt2_desc: Tear up the contract and eat the scorn of every court.
ev_loan_due_res2: The contract is torn up publicly; merchants everywhere remember {kingdom}.
ev_tax_farm_desc: A magnate offers three years of taxes up front to farm the collectors — good ledger, risky hearts.
ev_tax_farm_opt1_desc: Take the gold now; the resentment arrives later.
ev_tax_farm_res1: Three years of tax fill the vault; curses fill the streets.
ev_tax_farm_opt2_desc: The collectors stay under the crown, coin by coin.
ev_tax_farm_res2: The deal is refused; the crown keeps clean hands.
ev_war_bonds_desc: The war strains the purse: issue bonds to the people, redeem on victory.
ev_war_bonds_opt1_desc: The people subscribe eagerly; the war chest fills.
ev_war_bonds_res1: The bonds buy supplies; morale at the front soars.
ev_war_bonds_opt2_desc: No debts to the people; the war purse is cut to the bone.
ev_war_bonds_res2: The thin purse breeds grumbling in camp.
ev_land_survey_desc: The treasury asks leave to survey every field; hidden land, hidden tax — no more.
ev_land_survey_opt1_desc: Pay the surveyors now; next year the tax base is honest.
ev_land_survey_res1: The survey is done; hidden taxes flow to the vault.
ev_land_survey_opt2_desc: Too great a stir — {king} leaves the old ledgers alone.
ev_land_survey_res2: The survey is shelved; the old ledgers stay a muddle.
ev_guild_bank_desc: The craft guilds want a lending bank and offer the crown a share.
ev_guild_bank_opt1_desc: Invest and take dividends — and share the guilds' boat.
ev_guild_bank_res1: The bank opens; the crown collects yearly.
ev_guild_bank_opt2_desc: Keep the crown's name off moneylending; comfort the poor instead.
ev_guild_bank_res2: The crown declines and turns to charity instead.
ev_flood_desc: Days of rain; the river swallows the lowland villages.
ev_flood_opt1_desc: Put every hand on the dikes to save the lowlands.
ev_flood_res1: The dikes hold; the flood recedes and {kingdom} keeps its homes.
ev_flood_opt2_desc: The displaced scatter, carrying anger to every city.
ev_flood_res2: The flood leaves ruins and grudge on the banks.
ev_wildfire_desc: Dry winds push the wildfire toward villages and timber.
ev_wildfire_opt1_desc: Pay woodcutters to cut firebreaks and save the timber.
ev_wildfire_res1: The firebreaks stop the flames; the timber survives.
ev_wildfire_opt2_desc: Spend nothing; let the fire burn out.
ev_wildfire_res2: The burn leaves ash fields and weeping villagers.
ev_blizzard_desc: The blizzard kills herds and blocks the grain roads.
ev_blizzard_opt1_desc: Lend grain for the winter, repay in spring.
ev_blizzard_res1: The winter is survived; the grain returns in spring.
ev_blizzard_opt2_desc: Save the grain; count the frozen instead.
ev_blizzard_res2: When the snow stops, every village mourns.
ev_mine_collapse_desc: The mine caves in at night; families crowd the pit mouth.
ev_mine_collapse_opt1_desc: Spare no coin digging and comfort the widows.
ev_mine_collapse_res1: Most miners are pulled out alive; {kingdom} is praised.
ev_mine_collapse_opt2_desc: Abandon the trapped to save the seam.
ev_mine_collapse_res2: When the pit is sealed, the weeping lasts three days.
ev_river_dry_desc: The river fails; wheels stop and rice fields crack.
ev_river_dry_opt1_desc: Put crews on a channel from the upper waters.
ev_river_dry_res1: The channel runs; the rice fields live.
ev_river_dry_opt2_desc: Plant hardy crops — half the harvest, no expense.
ev_river_dry_res2: The dry fields yield half; the villages endure.
ev_rockslide_desc: After days of rain, a slide buries the pass on the trade road.
ev_rockslide_opt1_desc: Pay stonecutters to clear the pass quickly.
ev_rockslide_res1: The pass reopens to passing praise.
ev_rockslide_opt2_desc: Save the coin; caravans detour ten days.
ev_rockslide_res2: The detour costs ten days and the tolls shrink.
ev_heir_plot_desc: Secret word: {king}'s heir courts the generals. The blade is halfway from its sheath.
ev_heir_plot_opt1_desc: Arrest him at once — the court trembles, but the threat dies today.
ev_heir_plot_res1: The plot is crushed with an iron hand.
ev_heir_plot_opt2_desc: Gold and honors to feed his ambition.
ev_heir_plot_res2: Gold quiets the heir — for now.
ev_heir_plot_opt3_desc: Feign blindness and set the net; never startle the snake.
ev_heir_plot_res3: {king} watches and waits; the net is set.
ev_heir_plot_crushed_desc: The heir's faction is broken, but his men remain in every office. What now?
ev_heir_plot_crushed_opt1_desc: Confiscate across the board; the treasury swells.
ev_heir_plot_crushed_res1: The seized estates fill the treasury.
ev_heir_plot_crushed_opt2_desc: Punish only the chiefs; mercy earns gratitude.
ev_heir_plot_crushed_res2: Mercy is remembered in every court.
ev_concubine_rivalry_desc: Two consorts feud openly; the quarrels reach the throne room.
ev_concubine_rivalry_opt1_desc: Gifts for both — an uneasy peace.
ev_concubine_rivalry_res1: The harem quiets; the vault feels lighter.
ev_concubine_rivalry_opt2_desc: Demote and fine them both; restore order.
ev_royal_astrologer_desc: The astrologer reads a great omen in the stars — for a price to build the altar.
ev_royal_astrologer_opt1_desc: Better safe than sorry — pay for peace of mind.
ev_royal_astrologer_res1: The altar stands; all say heaven favors {kingdom}.
ev_royal_astrologer_opt2_desc: Call it sorcery and banish him; scholars cheer, priests seethe.
ev_royal_astrologer_res2: The astrologer is gone; the stargazers mind their tongues.
ev_hunt_accident_desc: At the autumn hunt, {king}'s horse bolts and tramples a commoner — before a crowd.
ev_hunt_accident_opt1_desc: A royal funeral, rich compensation, and {king} bows to the family.
ev_hunt_accident_opt2: By the letter of the law
ev_hunt_accident_opt2_desc: Let the magistrates pay the standard sum.
ev_hunt_accident_res2: The law is followed — no anger, no applause.
ev_hunt_accident_opt3_desc: Disperse the crowd and bury the story.
ev_hunt_accident_res3: The story is buried — but the hoofbeats are remembered.
ev_old_regent_desc: The old regent who ruled for years asks leave to retire home — the court holds its breath.
ev_old_regent_opt1_desc: Gold, honors, and a grand farewell.
ev_old_regent_res1: The old man leaves in tears; every court praises {king}'s grace.
ev_old_regent_opt2_desc: Reclaim the reins; the old man's grudge runs deep.
ev_old_regent_res2: Power returns to the crown — and a grudge to the court.
ev_bastard_claim_desc: A young man with an old token claims {king}'s blood and a place in the line.
ev_bastard_claim_opt1_desc: Verify and acknowledge him — the name and the scandal together.
ev_bastard_claim_res1: He is acknowledged; the markets buzz.
ev_bastard_claim_opt2_desc: Denounce the token as forged and drive him out.
ev_bastard_claim_res2: He is expelled, crying injustice at the gates.
ev_spy_ring_desc: The inner court proposes a spy ring over envoys and ministers.
ev_spy_ring_opt1_desc: Pay for ears everywhere; all lands whisper to {king}.
ev_spy_ring_res1: The ears are everywhere; {king} hears first.
ev_spy_ring_opt2_desc: The crown acts in daylight; spies are beneath {kingdom}.
ev_spy_ring_res2: The proposal dies; {king} keeps one line uncrossed.
ev_war_defector_desc: A veteran general defects with secrets — and intentions nobody can read.
ev_war_defector_opt1_desc: Execute him before the lines; the enemy will shudder.
ev_war_defector_res1: The execution chills the enemy army.
ev_war_defector_opt2_desc: Honor him and take his talents — with his heart untested.
ev_war_defector_res2: {king} greets the defector at the command tent.
ev_war_defector_opt3_desc: Refuse the defector; keep the honor clean.
ev_war_defector_res3: Sent away with honors; both armies call {king} old-fashioned honorable.
ev_defector_ambition_desc: The defector has grown his own power and obeys reluctantly. The old seed sprouts.
ev_defector_ambition_opt1_desc: Pay any price to break his command for good.
ev_defector_ambition_res1: His command is broken; the danger ends.
ev_defector_ambition_opt2_desc: A purge risks civil strife — endure for now.
ev_defector_ambition_res2: The calm holds — and everyone sees the crack.
ev_supply_convoy_desc: The supply convoy is ambushed; the escort begs for reinforcements.
ev_supply_convoy_opt1_desc: Pull men from the city to guard the grain roads.
ev_supply_convoy_res1: The roads reopen; the front steadies.
ev_supply_convoy_opt2_desc: Refuse and wish the convoy luck.
ev_supply_convoy_res2: The convoy is hit again; the front starves three days.
ev_fort_rebuild_desc: The border fort is falling apart; the warden asks to rebuild.
ev_fort_rebuild_opt1_desc: Pour gold into the bastion; the border sleeps easy.
ev_fort_rebuild_res1: The fort stands new; the border sleeps.
ev_fort_rebuild_opt2_desc: Border works can wait; spend elsewhere.
ev_fort_rebuild_res2: The fort stays broken; the border hears wolves at night.
ev_veteran_company_desc: Old soldiers ask to form a standing veteran company — for ordinary pay.
ev_veteran_company_opt1_desc: Pay them and let the veterans hold the border.
ev_veteran_company_res1: The veterans hold the border; banditry dies.
ev_veteran_company_opt2_desc: The purse is thin; send the old soldiers home.
ev_veteran_company_res2: The veterans go home; the taverns gain old war stories.
ev_privateer_licence_desc: A pirate chief offers gold for a privateer licence to prey on enemy shipping.
ev_privateer_licence_opt1_desc: Take the gold; {kingdom}'s seas gain licensed wolves.
ev_privateer_licence_res1: The privateers sail; gold and notoriety arrive together.
ev_privateer_licence_opt2_desc: Refuse and burn their ships as an example.
ev_privateer_licence_res2: The pirate ships burn like torches; the sea lanes are clean.
ev_hero_funeral_desc: The old warden of the border has died; the nation mourns and debates the rites.
ev_hero_funeral_opt1_desc: A full state funeral at the crown's expense.
ev_hero_funeral_res1: The whole nation lines the streets; envoys attend.
ev_hero_funeral_opt2_desc: Honor his will: a simple grave.
ev_hero_funeral_res2: The old general sleeps in a nameless grave — remembered anyway.
ev_market_fire_desc: A night fire guts half the market; the merchants lose everything.
ev_market_fire_res1: The new market opens busier than before.
ev_market_fire_opt2_desc: The merchants rebuild alone; the crown pays nothing.
ev_market_fire_res2: A shabby market returns; merchants sigh at tax time.
ev_water_shortage_desc: A dry summer empties the wells; lines form daily in the city.
ev_water_shortage_opt1_desc: Pay wellmasters to dig deep and channel water.
ev_water_shortage_res1: Sweet water reaches the city; the shortage ends.
ev_water_shortage_opt2_desc: Ration by household — cheap, but unpopular.
ev_water_shortage_res2: Rations cut the queues and raised the complaints.
ev_tenant_strike_desc: Rents rose once too often; the tenants refuse to pay and the estates sue.
ev_tenant_strike_opt1_desc: The crown leans on the landlords to cut rents.
ev_tenant_strike_res1: Rents are cut; the tenants cheer.
ev_tenant_strike_opt2_desc: Send officers to collect; law first.
ev_tenant_strike_res2: The rents arrive in full — and so do the cold stares.
ev_festival_request_desc: The people petition {king}: a good harvest deserves a city-wide festival.
ev_festival_request_res1: Three days of feasting; all speak well of {king}.
ev_festival_request_opt2_desc: Good times can wait; save for the bad ones.
ev_festival_request_res2: The petition is declined; the streets call {king} stingy.
ev_night_patrol_desc: Thieves rule the night; shops are robbed nightly and the guilds demand patrols.
ev_night_patrol_opt1_desc: Pay for a night watch and give the shops their sleep.
ev_night_patrol_res1: The watch walks; thieves vanish and shops rest.
ev_night_patrol_opt2_desc: The shops hire their own guards; the crown pays nothing.
ev_night_patrol_res2: Scattered guards lose to organized thieves.
ev_bathhouse_fad_desc: A bathhouse craze sweeps the city; the guilds ask the crown to champion more.
ev_bathhouse_fad_opt1_desc: Champion the baths; health for the whole city.
ev_bathhouse_fad_res1: Baths everywhere; {kingdom} is famous for cleanliness.
ev_bathhouse_fad_opt2_desc: The crown doesn't chase fashions; they fade.
ev_bathhouse_fad_res2: The fad fades; a few baths struggle on.
ev_traveling_fair_desc: A traveling fair rolls into the city, asking leave to trade under crown tax.
ev_traveling_fair_opt1_desc: Permit the fair and take the crown share.
ev_traveling_fair_res1: A fortnight of fair — taxes and cheers together.
ev_traveling_fair_opt2_desc: Fear the disorder; turn the fair away.
ev_traveling_fair_res2: The fair moves to the neighbor; the streets of {kingdom} feel quieter.
ev_royal_visit_desc: A neighboring royal house announces a visit — the pomp must match theirs.
ev_royal_visit_opt1_desc: Full state honors; guest and host delight.
ev_royal_visit_res1: A perfect visit, told fondly in every court.
ev_royal_visit_opt2_desc: Protocol by the book — polite, never lavish.
ev_royal_visit_res2: Correct but cold; the guests leave unimpressed.
ev_hostage_request_desc: A strong alliance demands a royal hostage as proof of friendship.
ev_hostage_request_opt1_desc: Send royal blood abroad for the alliance's ease — the palace weeps.
ev_hostage_request_res1: The hostage departs; the pact hardens, the palace grieves.
ev_hostage_request_opt2_desc: Plead the child's tender years; the ally loses face.
ev_hostage_request_res2: The refusal spreads; the ally takes offense.
ev_border_treaty_desc: The neighbor proposes a border treaty with fixed markers — an end to feuds.
ev_border_treaty_opt1_desc: Cede the disputed strip for a century of peace.
ev_border_treaty_res1: The markers stand; border brawls end.
ev_border_treaty_opt2_desc: Not an inch of the ancestors' land; double the border watch.
ev_border_treaty_res2: The talks collapse; the outposts eye each other.
ev_pirate_bribe_desc: The pirates send terms: pay, and {kingdom}'s ships sail safe.
ev_pirate_bribe_opt1_desc: Pay the toll; the ships fly the safe-passage flag.
ev_pirate_bribe_res1: The toll paid; {kingdom}'s ships sail untouched.
ev_pirate_bribe_res2: Several pirate bands fall; the rest remember.
ev_pilgrim_wave_desc: Word of miracles draws pilgrims to the borders of {kingdom}.
ev_pilgrim_wave_opt1_desc: Wayside shelters and soup for the pilgrims passing through.
ev_pilgrim_wave_res1: The pilgrims bless {kingdom} far and wide.
ev_pilgrim_wave_opt2_desc: Fear the crowds; close the border and turn them away.
ev_pilgrim_wave_res2: The pilgrims are turned away — and the holy fame with them.
ev_tribute_envoy_desc: A small far kingdom sends tribute and asks for {kingdom}'s protection.
ev_tribute_envoy_opt1_desc: Take the gifts — and the obligations of a protector.
ev_tribute_envoy_res1: The tribute is stored; the duty is written on {kingdom}.
ev_tribute_envoy_opt2_desc: Take nothing from the small; treat them as equals.
ev_tribute_envoy_res2: The tribute is declined; the small kingdom respects {kingdom} all the more.
toast_event_chain: An earlier choice bears new fruit — {kingdom} faces a fresh decision.
bank_disabled_note: (Banking is disabled in settings; this page is display-only.)
ev_caravan_ambush_desc: {king}'s caravan is ambushed at the border; the trade roads are afraid.
ev_caravan_ambush_opt1_desc: Hire escorts along the roads; trade steadies at once.
ev_caravan_ambush_res1: Escorts ride out; caravans move and markets relax.
ev_caravan_ambush_opt2_desc: No guarantees; the trade roads suffer for two years.
ev_caravan_ambush_res2: The roads stay cut; the slump is blamed on {kingdom}.
ev_trade_route_cut_desc: Half a year of cut routes: shops run dry, taxes shrink. {king} pays to reopen or holds firm.
ev_trade_route_cut_opt1_desc: Grease the right palms; the routes reopen.
ev_trade_route_cut_res1: The routes reopen; commerce tax recovers.
ev_trade_route_cut_opt2_desc: The land detour is slow and dear — but no one is paid off.
ev_trade_route_cut_res2: The land routes hold on barely; commerce stays above zero.
ev_bank_run_desc: Defaults spread and depositors storm the banks. Reserves run dry — {king} must act now.
ev_bank_run_opt1_desc: Fill the reserves from the crown vault and buy back confidence.
ev_bank_run_res1: The bailout calms the run; the market breathes again.
ev_bank_run_opt2_desc: Save the vault, not the banks — and watch the anger snowball.
ev_bank_run_res2: Bank failures erupt; the streets fill with furious depositors.
ev_bank_run_aftermath_desc: The run is over but trust is shattered. How will {king} mend it?
ev_bank_run_aftermath_opt1_desc: Spend gold to relief the ruined depositors.
ev_bank_run_aftermath_res1: The ruined regain faith; the market warms again.
ev_bank_run_aftermath_opt2_desc: No interference; time heals all ledgers.
ev_bank_run_aftermath_res2: The healing is slow; {kingdom}'s credit scar remains.
ev_guild_petition2_desc: The guilds petition {king} for franchise rights — and offer heavy gold.
ev_guild_petition2_opt1_desc: Take the gold and grant the rights; the rich gain, the poor lose.
ev_guild_petition2_res1: The franchise is granted; taxes soar, so do the grumbles.
ev_guild_petition2_opt2_desc: Keep the market fair; decline the deal.
ev_guild_petition2_res2: The petition is declined; guilds sulk, the people approve.
bank_enabled Description: Enable the banking & commerce system (city ledgers, central-bank panel, commerce tax, bank-run risk)
bank_money_supply_factor Description: Share of net loan growth added to the money supply (0-0.5); drives inflation and bubbles
bank_max_loans_per_city Description: Cap on active loans per city (keeps the ledger bounded)
bank_deposit_ratio_default Description: Share of resident wealth deposited into city banks yearly (0-30)
ruler_personality_enabled Description: Enable ruler personality: reads vanilla king traits and personality stats to sway AI law evolution, policy success, treasury skimming and event choices (parliament dampens)
